parameters.query:
insert into public.webhook_events (source, external_id, received_at, signature_ok, payload_hash) values ('paystack', $1, now(), true, $2)
on conflict (source, external_id) do nothing returning id;

select i.id, i.reference, i.tier_code, i.status, round(i.total_zar * 100)::bigint as total_cents from public.invoices_smc i
where i.reference = $1 or (i.status = 'issued' and i.broker_id = (select id from public.brokers where paystack_customer_code = $2 limit 1)) order by (i.reference = $1) desc, i.issued_at desc limit 1;

select json_build_object(
  'credit', (select row_to_json(c) from (select id, source, round(amount_zar*100)::bigint as amount_cents, reference_raw, parsed_reference, received_at, graph_message_id, external_id, match_status from public.bank_credits where id = $1::uuid) c),
  'invoices', coalesce((select json_agg(i) from (select id, reference, tier_code, status, round(total_zar*100)::bigint as total_cents, due_at, paid_at from public.invoices_smc where status in ('issued','paid','credited') and issued_at > now() - interval '120 days') i), '[]'),
  'credits', coalesce((select json_agg(x) from (select id, source, round(amount_zar*100)::bigint as amount_cents, reference_raw, parsed_reference, received_at, match_status, matched_invoice_id from public.bank_credits where received_at > now() - interval '3 days' and id <> $1::uuid) x), '[]'),
  'pricing', (select json_agg(p) from public.pricing p),
  'assign_invoice', (select row_to_json(a) from (select id, reference, tier_code from public.invoices_smc where id = nullif($2,'')::uuid) a),
  'assigned_by', nullif($3,'')) as ctx;

update public.bank_credits set match_status = case when $3 like 'manual_assign:%' then 'manual' else 'auto' end, matched_invoice_id = $2::uuid, assigned_by = nullif(split_part($3, ':', 2), '') where id = $1::uuid;
update public.bank_credits set match_status = 'unmatched', queue_reason = $2, queue_suggestions = $3::jsonb where id = $1::uuid;
update public.bank_credits set match_status = 'duplicate', duplicate_of = nullif($2,'')::uuid where id = $1::uuid;
update public.bank_credits set source = 'paystack_settlement', match_status = 'settlement' where id = $1::uuid;

parameters.query:
-- W16 mark paid (idempotent: only an 'issued' invoice flips; one cycles row per invoice).
-- $1 invoice_reference, $2 paid_at, $3 method, $4 paystack_reference, $5 bank_credit_id, $6 amount_cents, $7 idempotency_key
with inv as (
  update public.invoices_smc set status = 'paid', paid_at = $2::timestamptz, method = $3, paystack_reference = nullif($4, ''), bank_credit_id = nullif($5, '')::uuid
  where reference = $1 and status = 'issued'
    and abs(total_zar * 100 - $6::bigint) <= 100            -- +/-R1, re-checked in SQL
  returning *
), prev as (
  select c.broker_id, max(coalesce(c.extended_until, c.ends_at)) as last_end
  from public.cycles c join inv on inv.broker_id = c.broker_id
  where c.status in ('scheduled', 'active', 'extended') group by c.broker_id
), cyc as (
  insert into public.cycles (broker_id, tier_code, price_zar, committed_leads, replacement_cap, status, invoice_id, starts_at, ends_at)
  select inv.broker_id, inv.tier_code, p.price_zar, p.committed_leads, p.replacement_cap_cycle, 'scheduled', inv.id,
         prev.last_end, prev.last_end + interval '30 days'   -- renewal: back to back. First cycle: null until routing goes on (NH-CD-14)
  from inv join public.pricing p on p.tier_code = inv.tier_code left join prev on prev.broker_id = inv.broker_id
  on conflict (invoice_id) do nothing
  returning cycle_id, broker_id, starts_at
), audit as (
  insert into public.audit_log (actor, action, entity, entity_id, payload)
  select 'W16', 'payment.received', 'invoices_smc', inv.id::text, jsonb_build_object('reference', inv.reference, 'method', $3, 'idempotency_key', $7) from inv
)
select inv.id as invoice_id, inv.reference, inv.broker_id, inv.tier_code, cyc.cycle_id, cyc.starts_at, b.status as broker_status, b.routing_on,
       p.media_share_zar, b.billing_ref, b.email, b.whatsapp_number
from inv left join cyc on cyc.broker_id = inv.broker_id join public.brokers b on b.id = inv.broker_id join public.pricing p on p.tier_code = inv.tier_code;

parameters.content:
## W16 Payment received
Two rails, one event: Paystack webhook (A) or a bank credit from W17/W18/console (B) -> **Mark invoice paid + create cycle** (C).
- Signature verified on the raw body before parsing; webhook_events gives idempotency.
- Paystack payments are re-verified via the API and compared with the invoice (+/-R1) before marking paid.
- Unmatched, partial, overpaid, duplicate and already-paid credits never mark paid: console queue (W22).
- Card token stored only on opt-in, only in Vault.
- First cycle starts when routing goes on (NH-CD-14), so starts_at stays null here.
- Checkout (E): starts Paystack for an invoice; a tier change voids and re-issues the unpaid invoice.
See automation/billing/RUNBOOK.md.
